_meta.purpose: Seed watchlist for WQL Studio outlier radar (Weird Questions Lab)
notes: Subscriber counts are a snapshot at time of export; the app should refresh them.
Entries with channel_id null are well-known channels added by hand: resolve the handle to a channel ID in the app before tracking, and drop any that don't resolve.
Excluded: repost/compilation channels, AI-slop channels, kids-only channels, and channels under ~100 subs with no traction.

niche_tags.rising: Small channels growing fast in the niche (best for spotting fresh formats)
niche_tags.format: 2D animated Shorts channels to benchmark animation style, pacing and binge structure
